name: benchmark-blog
description: Pipeline CI : benchmarks → Markdown → GitHub Pages

scripts.gen:db: node benchmarks/db-latency.js | node generate/article.js --out content/posts --history data/history.json
scripts.gen:api: node benchmarks/api-throughput.js | node generate/article-api-throughput.js --out content/posts --history data/history-api.json
scripts.gen:fileio: node benchmarks/file-io.js | node generate/article-file-io.js --out content/posts --history data/history-fileio.json
scripts.pipeline: npm run gen:db && npm run gen:api && npm run gen:fileio
scripts.pipeline:fast: node benchmarks/db-latency.js --rows 10000 --runs 10 | node generate/article.js --out content/posts --history data/history.json
scripts.site:dev: npm run pages:generate && cd site && npm run dev
scripts.site:build: npm run pages:generate && cd site && npm run build
